context: Tests whether the agent lists records from a non-default directory with the --dir flag in the right position, reads status from frontmatter, distinguishes in-force from retired decisions, and knows the JSON command a CI gate consumes.

checklist.name: Uses list with --dir after the subcommand
checklist.description: Runs `pantheon-adr list --dir architecture/decisions` rather than reading files by hand. Credit ADR_DIR as an equivalent. Does not place --dir before the subcommand, and does not invent an index-file flag.

checklist.name: Reads status from frontmatter
checklist.description: Reports each record's status from its own frontmatter, including that use-rest-for-internal-services is superseded by adopt-grpc-for-internal-services.

checklist.name: Groups in force vs retired
checklist.description: Separates the three accepted records from the superseded one, naming each by slug.

checklist.name: Names the CI gate command
checklist.description: Gives `pantheon-adr status --json` and its shape, {total, by_status, by_type}. Credit `list -s <status>` as a partial answer.

checklist.name: Explains the non-record files correctly
checklist.description: Notes that README.md and the generated index.md are skipped because they are not records, and does not claim the CLI filters by a NNNN- naming pattern.
